# Vendored: PoPS (Polygenic Priority Score)

This directory is a verbatim copy of the PoPS gene-prioritization tool used in
the post-GWAS stage (`3_postgwas/scripts/30_pops_per_region.py`). It is **not**
our code and is left unmodified, under its original GNU GPL v3 license
(`LICENSE`).

Upstream: https://github.com/FinucaneLab/pops
Reference: Weeks, E. M. et al. Leveraging polygenic enrichments of gene features
to predict genes underlying complex traits and diseases. *Nat Genet* (2023).

The upstream `example/` data folder and the bundled paper PDF were removed to
keep the repository small; download them from upstream if you want the worked
example.
